author: DaiqingChen
title: Tenascin complex (GO:0090733) annotation update

author: pgaudet
body: Hi @DaiqingChen I assume that the paper I should cite is from the ontology ticket (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31064), PMID: 10842355. Since there were no annotations from that paper, I annotated all mouse and human orthologs as shown below: Thanks, Pascale

author: DaiqingChen
body: > Hi [@DaiqingChen](https://github.com/DaiqingChen) I assume that the paper I should cite is from the ontology ticket ([geneontology/go-ontology#31064](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31064)), PMID: 10842355. > > Since there were no annotations from that paper, I annotated all mouse and human orthologs as shown below: > > > Thanks, Pascale Hi Pascale, Yes the reference is indeed PMID: 10842355, sorry for not putting it in the request. The reference says "the tenascin (TN) family of glycoproteins (TN-C, TN-R, TN-W, TN-X, and TN-Y)", which are the Tenascin proteins. The corresponding gene of those are TNC, TNR, TNN, TNXB and TNXB chicken homolog. Seems like your annotation is matching their annotation, thank you! Best, Daiqing
